finding: A provider may accept a post while the local database write fails. The service reports success=true, recorded=false, but the review route previously responded as if the draft was successfully published and marked approval approved.
correction: Return HTTP 502 with an explicit reconciliation-required state, no provider identifier, and preserve the atomic approval claim to prevent automatic duplicate publication. No invented durable reconciliation or independent verification.
limitation: Crash between external acceptance and local persistence still requires durable provider-aware reconciliation and independent qualification. Frozen defect remains PARTIAL.
